note: Uncommitted experiment, measured and reverted. An empty synthetic log copied each accepted batch before the ack so a later fetch could serve the assigned base offset. The experiment kept the request bytes in Arc<Vec<u8>> and spliced that offset only when serving a fetch. Twelve interleaved pairs: paired mean records/s ratio 1.020, bootstrap 95% CI 0.990 to 1.050. Five of twelve pairs were slower. Every run acknowledged 20,000 records. The code was not kept. This is not a peer comparison and not a KL09-70 claim.
